fast.label: Fast
fast.description: Instant answers at a low cost.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Balance between quality and cost. Recommended.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: The project's agents. Each one is a versioned agent.py you can edit as a form or as code.
agents.deleteDescription: Its files are removed from the repository (they stay in the git history). Its traces are kept.

empty.title: This project has no agents
empty.description: Create an agent, give it instructions and tools, and try it in the playground.

create.title: New agent
create.description: The name identifies the agent in code, the API and traces. It cannot be changed later.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores; starts with a letter (max. 63).

errors.start: The name must start with a lowercase letter.
errors.chars: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
errors.taken: An agent with that name already exists in the project.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: What the agent can do. Actions with external effects ask for human approval by default.
tools.empty: The agent has no tools: it can only talk.
tools.pickerDescription: Messer built-in tools and actions from your active connections.
tools.catalogError: The tool catalog could not be loaded.
tools.actionsError: This connection's actions could not be loaded.
tools.noConnections: No active connections. Connect a tool in Connectors to use its actions.

locked.always: Sending emails always requires human approval.
locked.non_get: Requests other than GET always require human approval.

tools.allowedHostsHint: Empty = any public domain. Press Enter to add.
tools.knowledgeSearchNoKb: Knowledge search has no linked bases. Pick at least one in the Knowledge section.

knowledge_search.label: Knowledge search
knowledge_search.description: Searches the linked knowledge bases (vector, keyword or hybrid) and cites sources.

sql_query.label: SQL query (read-only)
sql_query.description: Queries a knowledge base's tables with a read-only role.

read_url.label: Read URL
read_url.description: Downloads a public web page and extracts its text.

web_search.label: Web search
web_search.description: Looks up current information on the internet.

calculator.label: Calculator
calculator.description: Evaluates arithmetic expressions without calculation mistakes.

current_datetime.label: Date and time
current_datetime.description: Returns the current date and time in a time zone.

http_request.label: HTTP request
http_request.description: Calls external APIs. Anything other than GET requires approval.

send_email.label: Send email
send_email.description: Sends an email on behalf of the organization after human approval.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Tools from remote servers that speak the MCP protocol (HTTP).
mcp.name: Name

none.label: Never
none.description: No tool from this server asks for approval.

destructive.label: Destructive actions
destructive.description: Tools marked as destructive ask for approval.

all.label: Always
all.description: Every call to the server asks for approval.

mcp.headersHint: Use $SECRET_NAME to reference a project secret instead of typing the key.

builder.codeSaved: Code saved; the configuration has been synced
builder.codeSavedCodeMode: Code saved. The agent is now in code mode: the configuration is read-only
builder.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
builder.notAnAgent: “{name}” is a workflow and is edited in the workflow builder.

notFound.title: Agent not found
notFound.description: There is no agent “{name}” in this project.

builder.codeModeBanner: agent.py no longer matches the form, so the configuration is read-only. Edit the agent in the Code tab.
builder.codeDirtyBanner: You have unsaved code changes. Save or discard them to edit the configuration.
builder.viewerBanner: Your role can view the agent but not change it.
builder.leaveDescription: This agent has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you leave.

errors.timeout_range: An integer between 1 and 3,600 seconds, or empty for no limit.
errors.variable_name: Variable names use letters, numbers and underscores, and do not start with a number.
errors.variable_duplicate: Some variables share the same name.
errors.topics_required: Add at least one banned topic.
errors.rubric_required: Write the rubric the judge must apply.
errors.mcp_name: The name uses lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.mcp_duplicate: Another MCP server already uses this name.
errors.mcp_url: The URL must start with https:// (or http:// locally).
errors.mcp_header: Header names only allow letters, numbers and hyphens.

general.title: General
general.descriptionHint: Shown in the project and helps other agents know when to delegate to this one.

model.title: Model and parameters
model.description: Pick a tier; Messer resolves the actual model from the configuration and the organization's data residency.
model.explicitActive: This model overrides the tier. Clear it to use a tier again.
model.temperatureHint: 0 = more precise, 1 = more creative. Empty = model default.
model.maxIterHint: Reasoning and tool rounds per message.
model.timeoutHint: Empty = no agent limit (the environment limit applies).

prompt.title: System instructions
prompt.description: What the agent is, how it should behave and what it must not do. Supports Markdown and '{{name}}' variables.
prompt.hint: Variables are replaced on every run by the values the channel sends or, if none arrives, by their default value.
prompt.placeholder: You are the billing assistant of '{{company}}'. Answer in the customer's language…
prompt.variablesEmpty: No variables. Type '{{name}}' in the instructions or add one.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Knowledge bases the agent can query with the search tool.
knowledge.empty: The organization has no knowledge bases yet.
knowledge.needsTool: Add the “Knowledge search” tool so the agent can use these bases.

contextFiles.title: Context files
contextFiles.description: Reference documents whose text is added to the agent's instructions.
contextFiles.uploaded: {count, plural, one {File added} other {# files added}}
contextFiles.formats: Formats: .md, .txt, .csv, .json, .yaml, .xml, .tsv, .html, .pdf and .docx. 5 MB per file at most.
contextFiles.removeDescription: The agent will stop receiving its content. The file stays in the repository history.
contextFiles.codeMode: In code mode, add context files by editing agent.py.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Checks on input and output. In shadow mode they are only recorded in the trace; in enforce mode they act.

modes.shadowHint: Only records it in the trace.

pii.label: Personal data (PII)
pii.description: Detects and masks emails, phone numbers, ID numbers, IBANs and the like.

secrets.label: Secrets
secrets.description: Masks API keys, tokens and passwords.

injection.label: Prompt injection
injection.description: Detects attempts to change the agent's instructions.

topics.label: Banned topics
topics.description: Refuses conversations about the topics you list.

judge.label: Judge with rubric
judge.description: A fast model reviews each answer against your rubric and asks for a retry if it fails.

guardrails.topicsHint: Press Enter or comma to add.
guardrails.rubricPlaceholder: The answer cites its source, makes no promises about deadlines and keeps a professional tone.

memory.title: Memory and compaction
memory.description: How the agent remembers the conversation between messages.
memory.disabledHint: Each message is handled without history.

last_turns.label: Last turns
last_turns.description: Keeps only the last N turns.

summarize.label: Summary
summarize.description: Summarizes the history when it grows too large.

code.syncHint: The form and the code stay in sync while agent.py uses Messer's patterns. If you write your own logic, the code wins.
code.codeModeBanner: This agent is edited as code: the form configuration is read-only.
code.configDirtyBanner: You have unsaved configuration changes. Save or discard them to edit the code.
code.viewerBanner: Your role can view the code but not change it.

versions.messageHint: A version pins the agent's current state so it can be deployed or restored.
versions.dirtyHint: Save or discard your changes before creating a version.
versions.restoreDescription: The agent's files go back to that version in a new commit. No history is lost.
versions.restoreDirty: Your unsaved changes will be discarded.

empty.title: No versions
empty.description: Save a version when the agent works as expected.

evals.description: YAML test cases ({path}) with validators. They run in the sandbox against the saved code.
evals.allPassed: {count, plural, one {The case passed} other {All # cases passed}}

empty.title: No evals run yet
empty.description: Run the evals to check the agent before deploying it.

noCases.title: No evals defined
noCases.description: Add YAML files in {path} to define test cases.

playground.title: Playground
playground.deleteConversationDescription: Its history and memory are deleted. The traces of its runs are kept.
playground.unsaved: There are unsaved changes: the playground uses the last saved version of the agent.
playground.emptyDescription: Type a message. You will see the answer in real time, the tools it uses and its cost.
playground.needsBuilder: You need the Builder role to try the agent.
playground.waitingOthers: Decision recorded. The run will continue once the other approvals are decided.
playground.stopped: Stopped. The run may continue on the server; check its trace.

tool.resumedResult: The result shows in the continuation.

footer.demo: The offline demo model answered (no model API key is configured).

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Write a message for the agent…
